title: What's New: VAT Date in Business Central (2023 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction and roadmap of VAT Date feature
Evolution and upcoming changes to VAT Date setup
Data population and localization of VAT Date field
Setup options and configuration of VAT Date usage
Default VAT Date and period controls
VAT Date consistency checks in posting procedure
Allowed VAT Date periods and field separation
VAT return period protection and compliance controls
Modifying VAT Date after posting and closing remarks

features.name: VAT Date field
features.description: New field added to separate VAT reporting from posting date, allowing users to choose a document date for VAT purposes. The field is populated with posting date for existing entries via upgrade code.
caveats: W1 feature available in most countries except Italy
Italy already had similar feature
In localizations without VAT system, field is called tax date

features.name: VAT Date Usage field options
features.description: Configuration field on General Ledger Setup with three options: Enable (allows modification), Prevent Modification (blocks changes after posting), and Disabled (hides field but system still uses it automatically with posting date).
caveats: Prevent Modification enabled by default for countries where VAT date cannot be modified after posting
If disabled, field is hidden but feature still operates with posting date as default

features.name: Default VAT Date setting
features.description: Configuration field on General Ledger Setup that determines whether VAT date defaults to posting date or document date when creating documents. Affects population of VAT date field and some posting calculations.
caveats: Can be changed only on non-posted documents
Will have impact on some postings

features.name: Control VAT Period setup
features.description: Configuration field that controls whether to check and potentially block posting when VAT date is defined within closed periods. Prevents posted documents with empty VAT date and ensures consistency in VAT reporting.
caveats: Can be disabled if not using VAT periods
Can prevent posting or provide warning only

features.name: VAT Date Consistency Checks
features.description: Three checks implemented in the posting procedure: defining a default VAT date if empty, ensuring VAT date is within allowed VAT posting data range, and ensuring VAT date is within non-closed VAT return periods.
caveats: Blank VAT date can be posted via APIs even though UI prevents it
Checks are implemented in code units involved in posting procedure

features.name: Allowed VAT Date Periods
features.description: Similar to allowed posting dates, administrators can define periods during which specified users can post with a particular VAT date. Initially used existing allowed posting from/to fields, but will be split into separate VAT-specific fields.
features.status_evidence_quote: based on your feedback we decided to split it in the version 23 uh it will be released in one of minor versions
caveats: Initial version used existing allowed posting from/to fields from GL setup
Version 23 will have separate fields in VAT setup
Upgrade code will copy existing values to new VAT setup fields

features.name: VAT Date modification after posting
features.description: Users can modify VAT date after posting a document from VAT entries if their setup allows. When saved, the change is propagated to posted documents and related GL entries based on transaction number, document number, document type, and posting date.
caveats: Only allowed if setup permits modification
Change propagates to posted documents and related GL entries

features.name: VAT Date in reports
features.description: VAT-based reports updated to use VAT date for filtering transactions. Reports include VAT statement, Calculate and Post VAT Settlement, VAT Declaration, and many others in both W1 and local reports. By default with standard setup, reports produce same output as before since posting date equals VAT date.
caveats: Reports only show different results if VAT date is manually edited or setup changed
By default posting date and VAT date are the same

features.name: VAT Period status handling
features.description: System can handle various VAT return statuses from open, accepted, closed to cancelled. Blocks new postings within closed VAT return periods or issues warning for released or submitted returns to prevent non-compliance situations.
caveats: Behavior can be configured to block, warn, or ignore via general ledger setup field

features.name: VAT Date redesign in version 23
features.description: Redesign of VAT date range separate from posting date range, addressing user feedback. Moves allowed posting from/to fields to separate VAT Date fields in VAT setup instead of using General Ledger setup fields.
features.status_evidence_quote: we decided to move this to V allow from uh posting it will come in next to min not immediately in October but this
caveats: Not immediately in October but in a later minor version
Upgrade code will copy existing GL setup values to new VAT setup fields
